description.zh:
要查询的网站域名。

> 域名必须已经配置过网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已经配置过网站业务转发规则的域名。
description.en:
The domain to query.

> The domain must have a web rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domains that have web rules.

description.zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。
description.en: An array of Anti-DDoS Pro instance IDs to query.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number to return. Default: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含转发规则的数量。取值范围：**1**~**10**。
description.en: The number of web rules per page. Valid values: **1** to **10**.

description.zh:
查询匹配模式。取值：
- **fuzzy**（默认）：表示模糊查询。
- **exact**：表示精确查询。
description.en:
The matching mode for the query. Valid values:

- **fuzzy** (default): Fuzzy search.

- **exact**: Exact match.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you omit this parameter, the system uses the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询已经创建的网站业务转发规则

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于分页查询您已创建的网站业务转发规则的配置，例如，转发协议类型、源站服务器地址、HTTPS配置、IP黑名单配置等。

调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateWebRule](~~157463~~)创建了网站业务转发规则。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This API runs a paginated query to retrieve the configurations of your web rules, such as the forwarding protocol type, origin server addresses, HTTPS settings, and IP blocklist configuration.

Before calling this API, you must first create a web rule by calling [CreateWebRule](~~157463~~).

### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this API is 50. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which can impact your services. Please plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-rules --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain example.com --cname kzmk7b8tt3510000.aliyunddos10140000 --query-domain-pattern exact --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-i7m27nf30000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
